implementation_state: ARCHITECTURE ONLY - no category is implemented by this task

architecture_status_legend.SUPPORTED: factor families and an existing calculation path are sufficient to build the category, subject to the P17 canonical category dimension
architecture_status_legend.PARTIAL: the category is factor-supported or structurally derivable but has a boundary, data or deduplication prerequisite that must be resolved first
architecture_status_legend.DEFERRED: a ratified decision or external reference data is required before the category can be bounded
architecture_status_legend.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no factor family, no methodology and no data contract exist; the category needs a new input contract and/or new factor set

raw_inventory_basis.source: emission_factors grouped by scope; all rows factor_source=DEFRA-DESNZ, factor_set=DEFRA-2025, reporting_year=2025, country=GB
raw_inventory_basis.note: The live inventory contains NO factor family that is inherently bound to a downstream boundary. A factor family is reusable across categories; therefore the category can never be derived from the factor alone and must be carried on the activity/result. This is the evidence basis for AD-P17-02.

categories.name: Purchased Goods and Services
categories.business_meaning: Upstream (cradle-to-gate) emissions of goods and services the organisation purchases, excluding capital goods (category 2), fuel/energy (category 3), upstream transport (category 4) and waste (category 5).
methodologies: spend_based (ONLY when no physical data exists AND explicitly authorised as spend-based on the result)
categories.factor_requirements: Supplier-specific factor, or a secondary/industry-average factor with a published material or activity basis. The Material use family (70 rows) is the only live family with a plausible category-1 basis, and it covers derived material production rather than a general goods taxonomy.
categories.factor_year_requirements: Exact reporting-year factor, or an explicitly recorded nearest-available year decision through controlled review. No silent substitution.
categories.geography_requirements: Factor country must match the purchase/consumption geography, or the mismatch must be an explicit operator decision.
categories.evidence_requirements: Purchase invoice/line evidence (raw description, raw quantity, raw unit) already modelled by evidence_line_items; supplier identity evidence for supplier-specific factors.
categories.supplier_requirements: The supplier must resolve through the existing org-scoped resolver. Ambiguity is a review state, never a silent choice.
manual_review_triggers: no eligible factor for the activity/unit
spend-based methodology would be required but is not explicitly authorised
supplier-specific factor claimed without supplier evidence
unit not compatible with any candidate factor
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per activity line, persisted as a Scope 3 / category 1 snapshot + emissions row, with methodology recorded (including spend_based where used).
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Supplier and factor selection are org-scoped; supplier-specific factors are org assets and must not leak to another tenant.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-01: one purchased-goods line extracted from a canonical source document, mapped to a supplier-specific or average factor with explicit methodology, calculated, persisted with category=1, evidence-linked and reportable.
prerequisite_work: category-1 factor coverage decision (PO decision on spend-based authorisation)
explicit methodology recording for spend-based lines

categories.name: Capital Goods
categories.business_meaning: Upstream (cradle-to-gate) emissions of capital goods purchased/acquired by the organisation (plant, machinery, vehicles, buildings) in the reporting period; a subset of purchased goods that is separately reported.
minimum_input_data: asset or facility the good is attributed to
categories.factor_requirements: No live factor family exists for capital goods. Delivering this category requires either a supplier-provided embodied figure (recorded as an explicit supplier figure with evidence, not as a factor) or a governed capital-goods factor set.
categories.factor_year_requirements: Same strict rule; an unavailability must fail closed rather than falling back to a general goods factor.
categories.evidence_requirements: Invoice/asset acquisition evidence plus, where supplier-specific, the supplier's embodied-emissions disclosure document.
categories.supplier_requirements: Same resolver; the capital-goods supplier is a first-class supplier record.
manual_review_triggers: no factor or supplier figure available
reporting-period treatment unclear (acquisition vs commissioning year)
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per capital good, category 2, with the attribution method recorded.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Asset records are org-scoped; a capital good may not be attributed to another tenant's asset.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-02: one capital good with either a supplier embodied figure (with evidence) or an authorised spend-based calculation, persisted with category=2 and no double counting against category 1.
prerequisite_work: capital-goods methodology decision (supplier figure vs spend-based vs new factor set)

categories.name: Fuel- and Energy-Related Activities Not Included in Scope 1 or Scope 2
categories.business_meaning: Upstream (well-to-tank) emissions of purchased fuels and energy, plus transmission and distribution losses, plus the upstream emissions of purchased electricity that is not already counted in Scope 1 or Scope 2.
minimum_input_data: reference to the existing Scope 1/2 activity or snapshot
accepted_activity_types: upstream fuel (WTT) for a Scope 1 fuel activity
T&D losses for a Scope 2 electricity activity
upstream electricity (WTT) for a Scope 2 electricity activity
methodologies: derive_from_source_activity (quantity inherited from the source Scope 1/2 record)
categories.factor_requirements: Live families are sufficient: WTT- fuels (114), WTT- UK electricity (2), WTT- heat and steam (3), WTT- bioenergy (49), Transmission and distribution (8), UK electricity T&D for EVs (272). Selection must exclude WTT factors from Scope 1 arithmetic and exclude non-WTT factors from category 3.
categories.factor_year_requirements: The WTT/T&D factor year must equal the reporting year of the source activity, or the mismatch is a review state.
categories.geography_requirements: Must match the country of the source activity.
categories.evidence_requirements: Category 3 normally derives from an already-evidenced Scope 1/2 activity; the derivation link is itself the evidence requirement, and it must be persisted.
categories.supplier_requirements: Supplier is inherited from the source activity where known; a category-3 line must not invent a supplier.
manual_review_triggers: no WTT/T&D factor for the fuel/energy type
the upstream factor would double-count an amount already inside Scope 1 or 2
T&D not applicable for a directly connected supply
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per derived line, category 3, with an explicit link to the source Scope 1/2 snapshot/activity.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: The derivation link may only reference a source activity in the same organisation; cross-tenant derivation must be denied.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-03: a WTT/T&D result derived from an existing Scope 1 or Scope 2 snapshot, persisted with category=3 and a persisted source link, and provably not re-adding the Scope 1/2 quantity.
prerequisite_work: category 3 -> source snapshot derivation link with a uniqueness constraint (double-count control DC-02)

categories.name: Upstream Transportation and Distribution
categories.business_meaning: Transportation and distribution of products purchased by the organisation, plus third-party transportation/distribution services the organisation pays for (inbound logistics), including warehousing.
accepted_activity_types: freighting goods by tonne.km / km / miles
categories.factor_requirements: Live families are sufficient: Freighting goods (1156), WTT- delivery vehs & freight (289). Units observed are km, miles, tonne.km. A category-4 claim is an UPSTREAM boundary; the same factor family is reused for category 9 (downstream), so the boundary must be an explicit recorded property of the activity.
categories.geography_requirements: Factor country/region must be consistent with the shipment geography; a GB factor must not silently price an IE shipment.
categories.evidence_requirements: Carrier invoice / consignment evidence: mode, mass, distance or fuel, period.
categories.supplier_requirements: Carrier/3PL must resolve as a supplier (org-scoped); ambiguity is reviewed.
manual_review_triggers: unit incompatible (km vs tonne.km vs litres)
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per shipment, category 4, with mode, distance basis and boundary recorded.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-04: one inbound shipment with mode and tonne.km, calculated and persisted with category=4 and an explicit upstream boundary flag.
prerequisite_work: explicit upstream/downstream boundary property on the activity (DC-04)

categories.name: Waste Generated in Operations
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from third-party disposal and treatment of waste generated by the organisation's owned/controlled operations.
accepted_activity_types: waste disposal by material and treatment route (landfill, open-loop, closed-loop, incineration with energy recovery, composting, anaerobic digestion)
categories.factor_requirements: The live Waste disposal family (134 rows, unit 'tonnes') is the correct factor base. The factor taxonomy is family > material > treatment route; a bare 'Waste' activity has no unique factor and MUST NOT be auto-matched.
categories.geography_requirements: Factor country must match the disposal jurisdiction.
categories.evidence_requirements: The waste transfer/service document; the printed material may be ambiguous, which is exactly why the clarification record is the evidence of the operator decision.
categories.supplier_requirements: The waste service provider is the supplier (live demo: 'Robinsons Recycling Services Ltd' resolved with mapped_supplier_id propagated to 25 emissions rows).
manual_review_triggers: treatment route not printed on the document
multiple plausible treatment routes with materially different factors (observed spread 4.647x between routes)
no eligible factor for the material/route
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per waste line, category 5, with the operator's selected factor and treatment route persisted as an adjudication.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Clarification/adjudication records are org-scoped; effective-context reuse must never cross tenants.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-05 (ALREADY PARTIALLY PROVEN): ambiguous Waste line -> clarification -> operator factor selection -> calculation -> 25 reportable Scope 3 rows totalling 1582.460460 kg CO2e, with 9 persisted activity_clarifications. P17 must add category=5 to this path and re-verify E2E through reporting.
prerequisite_work: category dimension on the waste path (P17-D)
reporting/disclosure E2E for the waste slice

live_evidence.factor_activity_type: Waste disposal > Construction > Metals - Landfill (kg CO2e) [tonnes]

categories.name: Business Travel
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from transportation of employees for business-related activities in vehicles not owned or operated by the reporting organisation (air, rail, land, sea), plus accommodation.
categories.factor_requirements: Live families are sufficient: Business travel- land (672), Business travel- air (112), Business travel- sea (12), Hotel stay (39), plus WTT variants. WTT variants must be routed to category 3, not category 6.
categories.geography_requirements: Air/sea factors are geography-sensitive; a mismatch is a review state.
categories.evidence_requirements: Travel booking/expense evidence with mode, distance/class and dates.
categories.supplier_requirements: Travel provider/agency where available; not mandatory unless a supplier-specific factor is used.
manual_review_triggers: travel class ambiguous (materially changes the factor)
a WTT variant selected for a category-6 line
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per trip/hotel line, category 6, with mode, class and distance basis recorded.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Employee-level attribution is personal data; the default reporting dimension is aggregate, not per-person, unless explicitly authorised.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-06: one air trip and one hotel line calculated from a canonical travel source, persisted with category=6.
prerequisite_work: WTT-vs-direct routing rule so WTT variants land in category 3 (DC-02)

categories.name: Employee Commuting
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from transportation of employees between their homes and their worksites, including homeworking energy where applicable.
categories.factor_requirements: Live coverage is thin: Homeworking (3) rows are directly usable; commuting by private car/rail can draw on Business travel- land (672) vehicle factors ONLY as an explicitly recorded estimated methodology, because those factors are built for business travel. A commuting-specific factor set would be preferable but is not present.
categories.geography_requirements: National average factors assumed; a mismatch must be explicit.
categories.evidence_requirements: Because commuting is normally estimated, the estimation record IS the mandatory evidence: method, inputs, assumptions, actor, timestamp, factor and source (see the no-silent-estimation rule).
manual_review_triggers: average-data factor reused from a business-travel family without an explicit estimate record
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per mode/period, category 7, always flagged as estimated with its estimation record persisted.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Home/work addresses are personal data and are never a reporting dimension; only aggregates leave the workflow.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-07: an explicit average-data commuting estimate (with its persisted estimation record) calculated and stored as category 7, marked secondary/estimated.
existing_factor_families: Business travel- land (672) as an explicitly-recorded proxy only
prerequisite_work: PO decision on whether average-data commuting estimates are authorised at all

categories.name: Upstream Leased Assets
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from the operation of assets the reporting organisation LEASES (is lessee of) and that are NOT already included in Scope 1 or Scope 2 under the chosen consolidation approach.
categories.factor_requirements: Fuels/WTT/Managed assets- vehicles (948) and Managed assets- electricity (4) provide the factor basis. The critical issue is not the factor but the BOUNDARY: the same asset could otherwise be counted in Scope 1/2 (operational control) or in category 8 (financial control / equity share), and this is governed by the organisational boundary decision, not by the factor.
categories.evidence_requirements: Lease agreement evidence (to establish the lessee relationship and consolidation treatment) plus the asset's activity evidence.
manual_review_triggers: consolidation approach not set for the organisation
asset already carries Scope 1/2 activity for the same period (see DC-07)
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per leased asset per period, category 8, with the consolidation approach recorded.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Lease and asset records are org-scoped; a lessor's data must not be readable by the lessee tenant and vice versa.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-08: one leased asset whose emissions are recorded as category 8 with an explicit consolidation approach, and a negative check proving the same activity period is not also present in Scope 1/2.
existing_factor_families: Fuels (Scope 1 family, reused for asset fuel)
prerequisite_work: organisation-level consolidation approach dimension (P17-H boundary work)

categories.name: Downstream Transportation and Distribution
categories.business_meaning: Transportation and distribution of sold products, paid for by the reporting organisation (outbound logistics), plus transport of sold products in vehicles not owned/controlled by the reporting organisation.
accepted_activity_types: outbound freighting by tonne.km / km / miles
categories.factor_requirements: Reuses Freighting goods (1156) and WTT- delivery vehs & freight (289) - the SAME families used by category 4. Category 4 and category 9 are therefore separable ONLY by an explicit boundary property on the activity (inbound vs outbound), which is a design invariant, not a convention.
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per outbound shipment, category 9, with the downstream boundary recorded.
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Downstream data may describe a customer's location; it is org-scoped and must not be exposed cross-tenant.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-09: one outbound shipment persisted as category 9 with a downstream boundary flag, and a check proving it is not also counted in category 4.
prerequisite_work: PO decision: which element of outbound logistics is in scope for the first delivery

categories.name: Processing of Sold Products
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from third-party processing of intermediate products sold by the reporting organisation, after sale and before final use. Distinct from category 1 (goods the organisation BUYS).
accepted_activity_types: downstream processing energy/fuel per unit of sold product
categories.factor_requirements: No live factor family represents downstream processing. Delivery requires either a processor-declared figure (recorded as an explicit supplier figure with evidence) or a new governed processing factor set. A general goods factor must NOT be substituted.
categories.evidence_requirements: Processor declaration or processing activity evidence
categories.supplier_requirements: The processor is a supplier-like entity and must resolve org-scoped
manual_review_triggers: sold product not an intermediate product
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per sold product processed, category 10
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Downstream processor data is org-scoped; the processor may be another tenant's entity and must not be linkable without authorisation.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-10: one sold intermediate product with a processor-declared processing figure persisted as category 10 with evidence.

categories.name: Use of Sold Products
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from the use of sold products by the end user, including direct (fuel/energy consuming) and indirect use-phase emissions, normally over the product's expected lifetime.
minimum_input_data: energy or fuel consumption per unit
accepted_activity_types: direct use-phase fuel/energy per unit sold
categories.factor_requirements: Fuel/energy factors already in the library can price a product's use-phase fuel, but the product-lifetime consumption model does NOT exist and must not be invented. Every assumption is a first-class, persisted, auditable artefact.
categories.factor_year_requirements: Exact year for the pricing factor; the use-phase period is a separately-recorded assumption, never conflated with factor year.
categories.geography_requirements: Use-market geography materially affects grid/fuel mix and must be explicit.
categories.evidence_requirements: Product specification / lifetime assumption record + the energy-per-use evidence.
manual_review_triggers: no assumption set authorised for the product type
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per product type per reporting period, category 11, with the full assumption set persisted
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Product and assumed-use data are commercially sensitive and org-scoped.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-11: one sold product with an explicitly persisted lifetime/use assumption set, calculated and stored as category 11.
prerequisite_work: PO decision to authorise a bounded use-phase methodology and which product types are in scope

categories.name: End-of-Life Treatment of Sold Products
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from third-party waste disposal and treatment of sold products at the end of their useful life.
accepted_activity_types: sold-product material mass by treatment route
categories.factor_requirements: The Waste disposal family (134 rows) can price a disposal route, but it is the SAME family used by category 5 (waste generated in operations). Separating category 5 from category 12 therefore requires an explicit waste-origin property (operational vs sold-product end-of-life) - the identical structural problem as categories 4/9.
categories.geography_requirements: End-of-life treatment jurisdiction; assumed-market treatment mixes must be explicit
categories.evidence_requirements: Product material composition and the assumed treatment route, both explicitly recorded
categories.supplier_requirements: None (or the waste contractor where known)
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per sold product material, category 12, with the treatment assumption persisted
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Org-scoped; sold-product composition may be commercially sensitive
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-12: one sold product with material composition and an explicit treatment-route assumption, persisted as category 12, fail-closed where the route is not evidenced (the P16 waste principle reused verbatim).

categories.name: Downstream Leased Assets
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from the operation of assets the reporting organisation OWNS and LEASES OUT to other parties (lessor position).
categories.factor_requirements: Same factor base as category 8 (Managed assets families, Fuels). Category 8 and 13 are separated ONLY by the direction of the lease (lessee vs lessor), which must be an explicit property of the lease relationship.
categories.evidence_requirements: Lease agreement establishing the lessor position; asset activity evidence
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per leased-out asset, category 13
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Lessee data belongs to another party; only aggregate asset emissions may be reported, and lessee identity must not leak across tenants.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-13: one leased-out asset persisted as category 13 with an explicit lessor/consolidation record and a negative check against category 8 and Scope 1/2.

categories.name: Franchises
categories.business_meaning: Emissions from the operation of franchises (businesses operating under a licence to sell/operate under the reporting organisation's brand), reported by the franchisor.
categories.factor_requirements: No franchise-specific family exists. Energy/fuel factors can price franchisee activity, but the franchise relationship and its allocation basis are new domain data, and a franchisee's data must never be assumed equivalent to owned operations.
categories.supplier_requirements: Franchisee is a distinct party; it must not be modelled as an ordinary supplier without an explicit decision
manual_review_triggers: franchisee data unavailable (estimate required, must be explicit)
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e per franchise per period, category 14, with the allocation basis and data source recorded
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Franchisees may be separate legal entities and possibly separate tenants; cross-tenant read must be denied by default and granted only through an explicit authorisation.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-14: one franchise with an explicitly recorded allocation basis, persisted as category 14.
prerequisite_work: PO decision on the franchise operating model and whether franchisees are tenants or external parties

categories.name: Investments
categories.business_meaning: Emissions associated with the reporting organisation's investments, including equity investments, debt investments and project finance (financed emissions).
minimum_input_data: financial data (outstanding amount or equity share) AND/OR investee activity data
accepted_activity_types: attributed share of investee activity/financial data
methodologies: BOUNDED: attribution_equity_share (investee activity x ownership share) is the ONLY methodology this contract defines. Any PCAF-specific data-quality scoring, financed-emissions asset-class treatment or sector attribution rules are DEFERRED / FRAMEWORK_SPECIFIC and are NOT authorised by this contract.
categories.factor_requirements: Investee activity would use existing activity factors; a financial-data-only approach (outstanding amount x sector factor) requires an economic-activity/sector factor set that does NOT exist in the library, so financial-data-only financed emissions is DEFERRED.
categories.factor_year_requirements: Exact reporting-year factor for the investee activity; investee reporting periods commonly lag, and a lag MUST be an explicit recorded decision rather than a silent substitution
categories.evidence_requirements: Investment record (holding, share, period) + investee emissions/activity evidence, or an explicit investee-reported figure with its source document
categories.supplier_requirements: Investee is not a supplier; it is a separate domain concept and must not be forced into the supplier model
manual_review_triggers: investee reporting period lags the reporting year (explicit decision required)
investment type outside the bounded methodology
categories.expected_output: kg CO2e attributed per investment, category 15, with the attribution method and share persisted
categories.tenant_security_considerations: Investee data is highly sensitive and may belong to another tenant; cross-tenant exposure must be denied by default with an explicit authorisation path only.
categories.e2e_acceptance_scenario: IA-S3-15 (BOUNDED): one equity investment with an explicit ownership share and an investee activity/emissions figure, calculated by attribution_equity_share only, persisted as category 15.
prerequisite_work: PO decision ratifying the bounded attribution_equity_share methodology and explicitly deferring PCAF

structural_finding: Every Scope 3 category is separated from its neighbour by a BOUNDARY or ORIGIN property, never by the factor family. Categories 4/9 (inbound vs outbound transport), 5/12 (operational waste vs sold-product end-of-life) and 8/13 (lessee vs lessor assets) share factor families outright. Therefore the canonical category model MUST carry an explicit boundary/origin dimension on the activity, and the factor library must never be treated as evidence of category coverage - which is exactly what the P14 reconciliation already concluded about the 4,090 Scope 3 factors.
no_silent_estimation_rule: Where a category is normally estimated (notably 7, 11, 12 and 14), the estimate is a persisted, first-class artefact carrying method, inputs, assumptions, factor, source, actor and timestamp. A missing activity quantity is never converted into an arbitrary quantity.
no_silent_reclassification_rule: Category is never changed automatically on an existing result. A reclassification is a new result plus a supersession link through the existing P16 reportability lifecycle, with an actor, reason and timestamp.
